snippet.title: KYRO - Official Launch Trailer | Boss Fights & Gameplay
snippet.description:
Play KYRO now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063690/KYRO/

Get ready for combat! Check out the intense boss fights and high-speed action in the official launch trailer for KYRO.

Guide Aiden through the dangers of Ka'a and test your skills in this top-down pixel art action-adventure. Explore a sci-fi Amazonian world full of mysteries, master the combat mechanics, and survive the ultimate challenges that await.

Developed by CHUVA Studio.
https://chuvastudio.com/

Follow CHUVA Studio:
Twitter/X: @ChuvaStudio / @andrewsnycollas
Instagram: @chuva_studio / @andrewsnycollas_
YouTube: @CHUVAStudio
